4.text: of Yaˊyaq by his own people would destroy all grounds for blood-revenge,

5.text: and prevent further trouble. In still another case that I know of a man

6.text: named Qaˊvrêtto was killed by his cousin in a quarrel. After the deed, the

7.text: murderer married the wife of his victim, and joined the two herds together.

8.text: The victim left a small son, who had to live in the camp of the murderer.

9.text: Nobody protested against the deed. The Chukchee who told me the details

10.text: of the affair said, “What is to be done? This is their own business” (Qailoˊ-

11.text: qɪm miˊñkri. Eˊrrɪg̣-liˊi; literally, “Of course how, their knowledge”).

12.text: I will also mention a couple of cases of a somewhat different character,

13.text: although they happened within the family.

14.text: A mother killed her boy with a blow of a heavy stick. The boy was

15.text: about seven years old. The father was, as the Chukchee says, “a soft one”

16.text: (yɪˊrkum-vaˊlɪn), and nothing further happened. In two cases men killed their

17.text: wives, — one with a fire-brand, and the other with a kick of the foot in her

18.text: abdomen. Moreover, the second woman was with child. Both murders remained

19.text: without consequences. In a third case, however, a rich reindeer-breeder on

20.text: the western Kolyma tundra, Qituˊwg̣i, who happened to murder his wife, had

21.text: to pay a heavy fine to the brother of the one killed. He gave nine reindeer,

22.text: among them two driving-teams and a number of the best fawn-skins. I was

23.text: told, however, that even this fine was moderate, the killed one being a woman

29.text: MURDER AND BLOOD-REVENGE OUTSIDE OF THE FAMILY. — A murder com-

30.text: mitted outside of the family-group rarely remains unavenged. “It is a bitter

31.text: shame to leave blood unpaid for,” say the Chukchee. “Even the remote

32.text: kinsmen have to take it to heart. A friend, too, must avenge his friend,

33.text: and, much more, his group-marriage companion.”

34.text: I have already mentioned that the union of those who have to take part

35.text: in blood-revenge is designated by a special term, čiˊn-yɪrɪn, “heart-company”

36.text: (from the root čiñ, identical with liñ). These are, first of all, kinsmen in the

37.text: father’s line (“those from the old-buck side”). It is said that kinsmen in the

38.text: mother’s line (“those from the matrix side”) have to appear as avengers only

39.text: when there is nobody to undertake it in the father’s line. The son-in-law,

40.text: who lives in the house of his wife as an adopted son, is considered as a
